description: Converts every property of a reactive object into a ref linked to the source, so the result can be destructured.
`toRef(obj, 'key', default?)` links one property; `toRef(() => value)` creates a read-only getter ref (3.3+).
Normalizes a value, ref or getter into its current value (3.3+). Reactive when called inside an effect.
Type for composable inputs that accept `T`, `Ref<T>` or `() => T`.
Vue 3.5 compiles `const { a } = defineProps()` so `a` reads `props.a` reactively. Works only for props.
